```{=html}
<!--
This page is meant to live in the stac-apr-site repo, next to the other
.qmd pages (e.g. alongside CBS/cbs-lea.qmd), so it inherits the site's
brand.yml / styles.css automatically.

DATA: this page no longer reads pre-exported CSVs. The {r} chunk right below
sources 00-prepare-climate-data.R -- which pulls the raw Qualtrics export
from Box and cleans it -- and hands the resulting data frames to Observable
JS via ojs_define(). That means:
  - 00-prepare-climate-data.R must sit next to this .qmd (or update the
    source() path below).
  - Whoever runs `quarto render` / `quarto preview` needs R installed, with
    the tidyverse/janitor/readxl packages, and needs Box Drive synced (same
    as running any of the numbered analysis scripts).
  - There's no manual export/copy step anymore -- the page always renders
    from a fresh pull of the data.
  - The published static HTML is unaffected: the data gets baked into the
    page at render time, so site visitors still get a fully static page
    with no server and no R dependency on their end.

If you'd rather work from flat CSVs (e.g. for Tableau/Excel), you can still
run 05-export-for-dashboard.R separately -- it sources the same prep script
and writes the two CSVs out, but this page doesn't need them.

All filtering, aggregation, and chart rendering below runs client-side via
Observable JS (OJS) -- no server needed, so this works as static content on
GitHub Pages just like the rest of the site. The percentage/count logic in
the OJS cells below was verified in Node against the real exported data
before this file was written; the layout/rendering itself should still get
a `quarto preview` check on your end.
-->
```

Select a Cohort, Region, and/or LEA below to filter every chart on this page. Hover any bar for details.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

source("00-prepare-climate-data.R")

ojs_define(
  climate_data_bridge = school_climate_long,
  phase_defs_bridge    = phase_definitions
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
```

```{ojs}
html`<div style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 14px; text-align:center;">
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
filteredLong = data.filter(d =>
  (cohortFilter === "All" || d.cohort === cohortFilter) &&
  (regionFilter === "All" || d.region === regionFilter) &&
  (leaFilter === "All" || d.lea === leaFilter)
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// climate fields repeat identically across a school's 5 strategy-rows, so
// dedupe back to one row per school for anything that isn't strategy-specific
filteredSchools = filteredLong.filter(d => d.strategy === strategyKeys[0])
```

## School Climate Measure

### "Does your school currently collect data and track progress on school climate?"

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
q137Agg = {
  const rows = filteredSchools.filter(d => d.climate_tracks_data);
  const groups = d3.rollup(rows, v => v.length, d => d.climate_tracks_data);
  const total = d3.sum(Array.from(groups.values()));
  return ["Yes", "No"].map(k => ({
    category: "All Schools", key: k,
    n: groups.get(k) ?? 0,
    pct: total > 0 ? (groups.get(k) ?? 0) / total : 0
  }));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Two-point scale: first 2 colors from the shared blue scale (darkest -> lightest)
q137Color = ({ Yes: "#346FAB", No: "#AACCE9" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 120,
  marginBottom: 50,
  width: width,
  height: 150,
  style: { fontSize: "15px", color: "black" },
  x: { percent: true, label: "% of Respondents", labelAnchor: "center" },
  y: { label: null },
  color: { domain: ["Yes", "No"], range: ["Yes", "No"].map(k => q137Color[k]), legend: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(q137Agg, Plot.stackX({
      x: "pct", y: "category", fill: "key",
      title: d => `Tracks school climate data: ${d.key}\n% of Respondents: ${(d.pct * 100).toFixed(0)}%\nn = ${d.n}`
    })),
    Plot.text(q137Agg, Plot.stackX({
      x: "pct", y: "category",
      text: d => d.pct >= 0.04 ? `${(d.pct * 100).toFixed(0)}%` : "",
      fill: "white", fontWeight: "bold"
    })),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```

### "Our school climate has improved since we started implementing the CCSPP"

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof climateFormat = Inputs.radio(
  ["5-point scale", "Agree / Neutral / Disagree"],
  { value: "Agree / Neutral / Disagree", label: "View:" }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
q171Order = climateFormat === "5-point scale"
  ? ["Strongly disagree", "Somewhat disagree", "Neither agree nor disagree", "Somewhat agree", "Strongly agree"]
  : ["Disagree", "Neutral", "Agree"]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
q171Key = climateFormat === "5-point scale" ? "climate_improved" : "climate_agree3"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Shared blue (-> orange) scale, darkest/bluest = most positive:
//   75-100% #1F4E79   50-74% #2E75B6   25-49% #9DC3E6   1-24% #F4B183   0% #C55A11
// 5-point scale uses all 5, in order from most to least agreement.
// 3-point scale uses just the 3 blues, in the same progressive order.
q171Color = climateFormat === "5-point scale"
  ? ({
      "Strongly disagree": "#C55A11",
      "Somewhat disagree": "#F4B183",
      "Neither agree nor disagree": "#9DC3E6",
      "Somewhat agree": "#2E75B6",
      "Strongly agree": "#1F4E79"
    })
  : ({ "Disagree": "#AACCE9", "Neutral": "#6EA1CE", "Agree": "#346FAB" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
q171Agg = {
  const rows = filteredSchools.filter(d => d[q171Key]);
  const groups = d3.rollup(rows, v => v.length, d => d[q171Key]);
  const total = d3.sum(Array.from(groups.values()));
  return q171Order.map(k => ({
    category: "All Schools", key: k,
    n: groups.get(k) ?? 0,
    pct: total > 0 ? (groups.get(k) ?? 0) / total : 0
  }));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 120,
  marginBottom: 50,
  width: width,
  height: 150,
  style: { fontSize: "15px", color: "black" },
  x: { percent: true, label: "% of Respondents", labelAnchor: "center" },
  y: { label: null },
  color: { domain: q171Order, range: q171Order.map(k => q171Color[k]), legend: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(q171Agg, Plot.stackX({
      x: "pct", y: "category", fill: "key",
      title: d => `Our school climate has improved: ${d.key}\n% of Respondents: ${(d.pct * 100).toFixed(0)}%\nn = ${d.n}`
    })),
    Plot.text(q171Agg, Plot.stackX({
      x: "pct", y: "category",
      text: d => d.pct >= 0.04 ? `${(d.pct * 100).toFixed(0)}%` : "",
      fill: "white", fontWeight: "bold"
    })),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```

## Capacity-Building Strategies: Phase of Growth vs. School Climate

Pick a strategy below to see how a school's phase of growth on that particular strategy relates to the two school climate measures above.

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
Rows: Visioning / Engaging / Transforming / Null (no response)
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
phaseOrder = ["Visioning", "Engaging", "Transforming", "Null"]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof cbsStrategyFilter = Inputs.select(strategyKeys, { label: "CBS Strategy:", value: strategyKeys[0] })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
cbsScopedLong = filteredLong.filter(d => d.strategy === cbsStrategyFilter)
```

### "Does your school currently collect data and track progress on school climate?"

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Same 2-blue scale used for the Yes/No chart above, kept as its own copy
// here so this section doesn't depend on a cell defined earlier in the page.
cbsTrackColor = ({ Yes: "#346FAB", No: "#AACCE9" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
cbsTrackAgg = {
  const rows = cbsScopedLong.filter(d => d.climate_tracks_data);
  const groups = d3.rollup(rows, v => v.length, d => d.phase, d => d.climate_tracks_data);
  const result = [];
  for (const phase of phaseOrder) {
    const respMap = groups.get(phase) ?? new Map();
    const total = d3.sum(Array.from(respMap.values()));
    for (const response of ["Yes", "No"]) {
      const n = respMap.get(response) ?? 0;
      const pct = total > 0 ? n / total : 0;
      result.push({ phase, response, n, total, pct });
    }
  }
  return result;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 120,
  marginBottom: 50,
  width: width,
  height: 260,
  style: { fontSize: "15px", color: "black" },
  x: { percent: true, label: "% of Respondents", labelAnchor: "center" },
  y: { label: null, domain: phaseOrder },
  color: { domain: ["Yes", "No"], range: ["Yes", "No"].map(k => cbsTrackColor[k]), legend: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(cbsTrackAgg, Plot.stackX({
      x: "pct", y: "phase", fill: "response",
      title: d => `${cbsStrategyFilter}\n` +
                   `Phase of Growth and Development: ${d.phase}\n` +
                   `Tracks school climate data: ${d.response}\n` +
                   `% of Respondents: ${(d.pct * 100).toFixed(0)}%\nn = ${d.n}`
    })),
    Plot.text(cbsTrackAgg, Plot.stackX({
      x: "pct", y: "phase",
      text: d => d.pct >= 0.06 ? `${(d.pct * 100).toFixed(0)}%` : "",
      fill: "white", fontWeight: "bold"
    })),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```

### "Our school climate has improved since we started implementing the CCSPP"

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
cbsResponseOrder = ["Disagree", "Neutral", "Agree"]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Same 3-blue scale used for the Agree/Neutral/Disagree chart above, kept as
// its own copy here so this section doesn't depend on a cell defined earlier
// in the page.
cbsClimateColor = ({ Disagree: "#AACCE9", Neutral: "#6EA1CE", Agree: "#346FAB" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
cbsClimateAgg = {
  const rows = cbsScopedLong.filter(d => d.climate_agree3);
  const groups = d3.rollup(rows, v => v.length, d => d.phase, d => d.climate_agree3);
  const result = [];
  for (const phase of phaseOrder) {
    const respMap = groups.get(phase) ?? new Map();
    const total = d3.sum(Array.from(respMap.values()));
    for (const response of cbsResponseOrder) {
      const n = respMap.get(response) ?? 0;
      const pct = total > 0 ? n / total : 0;
      result.push({ phase, response, n, total, pct });
    }
  }
  return result;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 120,
  marginBottom: 50,
  width: width,
  height: 260,
  style: { fontSize: "15px", color: "black" },
  x: { percent: true, label: "% of Respondents", labelAnchor: "center" },
  y: { label: null, domain: phaseOrder },
  color: { domain: cbsResponseOrder, range: cbsResponseOrder.map(k => cbsClimateColor[k]), legend: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(cbsClimateAgg, Plot.stackX({
      x: "pct", y: "phase", fill: "response",
      title: d => `${cbsStrategyFilter}\n` +
                   `Phase of Growth and Development: ${d.phase}\n` +
                   `Our school climate has improved: ${d.response}\n` +
                   `% of Respondents: ${(d.pct * 100).toFixed(0)}%\nn = ${d.n}`
    })),
    Plot.text(cbsClimateAgg, Plot.stackX({
      x: "pct", y: "phase",
      text: d => d.pct >= 0.06 ? `${(d.pct * 100).toFixed(0)}%` : "",
      fill: "white", fontWeight: "bold"
    })),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```
